description: This file contains low power management and clock configuration functions for the NXP i.MX RT1064 processor, including PLL initialization, clock switching, and power mode transitions.

methods.name: clock_set_mux
methods.description: Sets the clock multiplexer to a specified value, with handshake wait if needed.

methods.name: clock_set_div
methods.description: Sets the clock divider to a specified value, with handshake wait if needed.

methods.name: clock_init_usb1_pll
methods.description: Initializes the USB1 PLL with provided configuration, including bypass and lock wait.

methods.name: flexspi_enter_critical
methods.description: Prepares FLEXSPI for low power mode by waiting for inactivity and disabling clock gating.

methods.name: flexspi_exit_critical
methods.description: Restores FLEXSPI after low power mode by re-enabling clock gating and resetting.

methods.name: clock_full_power
methods.description: Configures clocks and PLLs for full power operation, including setting PLLs, dividers, and clock sources.

methods.name: clock_low_power
methods.description: Configures clocks for low power mode, reducing frequency and disabling PLLs.

methods.name: clock_lpm_init
methods.description: Initializes low power mode callbacks and reads current PLL configurations.
